Two constructed Apple share histories satisfy the stated annual and quarterly quantity constraints but differ at day100. Their dates are illustrative, not inferred actual transactions.
A full-value award can deliver80 common shares while consuming160 reserve shares; an option delivering80 can consume100 under its separate rule.
Plan permission does not override narrower award terms or fill blank grant inputs. No new confirmed defect.
